decisions.reason: Changing the editable-field mechanism does not remove or alter the independent requirement that interactive fields have labels.
A more robust field mechanism may implement the behavior differently, but the requirement that placeholder text clear on activation remains unchanged.
The source decision concerns editable-field controls and does not change the template theme-color requirement.
The editable-field mechanism is independent of Tab-controlled list hierarchy and does not resolve or alter its existing ambiguity.
The source decision does not address graphic bullet appearance or any of its current design attributes.
The request for a more robust editable-field approach does not change legacy copy-paste expectations or resolve the existing workflow ambiguity.
The editable-field mechanism does not alter the requirement for reliable manual line breaks after pasted content.
The source decision concerns form-field controls rather than the required style set or its coverage across templates.
No typography, font, emphasis, or spacing attribute is changed by the editable-field mechanism decision.
The source decision does not concern pasted-table layout or resolve the existing table-adjustment conflict.
The task-local assessment deliverable and its outputs remain unchanged by the later editable-field design decision.
